title: Taiwan Produce Watch produce category registry
description: Site-wide produce category registry (Issue #44 Part B). tpw.categories is the single source of truth for the cross-field rules this schema cannot express: season_source is required if and only if season_semantics is official_season_registry; buy_score_eligible=true is allowed only for id fruit or vegetable (SPEC.md section 9.2.1); icon_fallback_symbol must equal produce-<id>-fallback; fruit and vegetable must both exist as official_season_registry watchlist categories; and array order is the checked-in display order (never re-sorted).

season_source.description: Non-null if and only if season_semantics is official_season_registry; enforced by tpw.categories, not expressible here.

buy_score_eligible.description: true is allowed only for id fruit or vegetable (SPEC.md section 9.2.1); enforced by tpw.categories.
